purpose: Original genus-level fossil form informed by photographs of historical Cucullaea (Idonearca) vulgaris, now captioned Idonearca vulgaris. Not an exact specimen or measured multi-view reconstruction.
coverage_justification: 24 full azimuth views plus six canonical views, clay, alternate light, wire, paired umbo and long dorsal hinge detail.

scale.source: S1 photo caption 4.9 cm; an artistic nominal anchor only
scale.depth_height: Inferred; S2 3.2 cm is a separate specimen and not used as model depth

feature_obligations: Deep inflated paired valve volumes, not a flat badge or mechanical cube.
Oblique rounded quadrangular side silhouette with broad rounded corners.
Paired umbones and long near-straight dorsal hinge zone, with quiet reconstructed margin.
Restrained concentric growth bands continuous on shell, no radial scallop ribs or biological white spots.
Continuous narrow closed seam, no unseen hinge teeth or interior anatomy.
Only 49 mm nominal side length source-anchored; do not combine two different specimens into measured geometry.

criteria.description: Source, exact export, official format, deterministic rebuild and metric scale/budget checks.
Open exact-export views; judge defining inflated paired valves, long hinge, paired umbones and rounded quadrangular form.
Check two real photographs and distinguish artistic interpolation from measured or taxonomic claims.
Editable source, source/config and reproducible delivery with accurate limits.
Pinned Three.js 0.180.0 exact GLB GLTFLoader parse.
Actual target GPU rendering remains unknown until separately evidenced, not a making prerequisite.
Actual populated-scene testing remains unknown until separately evidenced, not a making prerequisite.

revision_note: Final making revision: oblique rounded posterior shoulder matches the broad trapezoidal photograph rather than a mechanical box. Convex outer valves, paired rounded dorsal umbones and near-straight hinge retained.
delivery_contract_freeze_note: Source checksum added after actual build, before final evidence rendering; no structure, claim, scale or material requirement changed.
